title: A Modern Web App in C
summary: An article demonstrating how to build a modern web application using the C programming language, showcasing that C remains viable for contemporary web development beyond traditional systems programming.
problem_solved: Challenges the misconception that C is only suitable for low-level systems work by demonstrating a full-stack web application implementation.
why_valuable: Provides insights into web fundamentals through C's low-level approach, offering performance benefits and deeper understanding of HTTP, sockets, and request handling.
